strong_acid_strong_base_hcl_naoh.explanation: The equivalence point (25.0000 mL) is defined by stoichiometry alone (moles of titrant delivered equal moles of analyte). Phenolphthalein changes colour where the solution's own pH crosses the indicator's pKin (9.4), which the solved curve places at 25.0126 mL -- a difference of +0.0126 mL. The two differ because the indicator's colour change is a property of the dye's own acid/base equilibrium, not of the titration; they coincide only when pKin equals the pH at equivalence.
